\]
This implies that
\[
\frac{f(2x)}{f(x)} = f'(x) + f(x).
\]
Let $g(x) = \frac{f(x)}{e^x}$. Then,
\[
g'(x) = \frac{f'(x)e^x - f(x)e^x}{(e^x)^2} = \frac{f'(x) - f(x)}{e^x}.
\]

\]
